free_tier.stated: 500 MiB per version file (hard code-level cap: `read_from_field(field, 500 * (1 << 20), "Project file exceeds the maximum of 500MiB...")`). No stated total-account storage quota. Per-user quotas read from `user_limits`: projects = 256, projects_per_day = 10, versions_per_project = 10000, versions_per_day = 150.

egress.terms: Free. All files served from cdn.modrinth.com behind Cloudflare with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, no auth, no signed URLs, no expiry.

tooling: Documented public REST API v2 (api.modrinth.com/v2/project/{id}/version, POST /version with multipart file upload + PAT auth); labrinth OpenAPI spec published at docs.modrinth.com. No rclone backend, but the API is simple enough for a dozen-line client.
chaining: 256 projects x 10,000 versions/project x 500 MiB = ~1.22 PiB theoretical per account; practically throttled by versions_per_day=150 -> 150 x 500 MiB = 73 GiB/day/account = ~2.2 TiB/month/account. Unlimited free accounts; each new account resets all four counters. Idle accounts keep all existing files downloadable forever (no TTL on published versions).
limits_note: 500 MiB/version-file; 150 version uploads/day; 10,000 versions per project; 256 projects; version_number must be unique per project (1-32 chars); moderation may reject non-mod content; project file type must be in project_file_type allowlist (jar/zip/mrpack etc.), so arbitrary blobs need wrapping.
reliability_note: Moderated registry: junk projects can be removed and files hard-deleted; no rate-limit survival guarantee past 150 uploads/day.
